cohort: The study included 1126 pregnant women (828 SARS-CoV-2 negative and 298 SARS-CoV-2 positive) from a third-level health center who underwent universal screening by RT-qPCR.
finding: Low maternal PCR CT values (<25) were significantly associated with a higher percentage of placental fibrinoid, and symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection was significantly associated with preeclampsia, particularly when diagnosed at <35 gestational weeks.
gest_age: The study included women across various gestational ages, with specific findings highlighted for those diagnosed at <35 gestational weeks.
